title: Urgent: Your Account Will Be Suspended
message:
From: security@yourbank-support.com
Subject: URGENT - Account Suspension Notice

Dear Customer,

We detected unusual activity on your account. Click the link below within 24 hours to verify your identity or your account will be permanently suspended.

[Verify My Account Now]

Thank you,
Security Team

choices.text: Click the link and enter your login details to verify your account.
choices.feedback: This is exactly what the attacker wants. Legitimate banks never ask you to verify your identity through an urgent email link.

choices.text: Delete the email and log into your bank account directly through the official app or website to check for issues.
choices.feedback: Correct. Going directly to the official site/app instead of clicking email links avoids phishing links entirely.

choices.text: Reply to the email asking for more information.
choices.feedback: Replying confirms your email address is active and monitored, which attackers can use for future targeting.

warningSigns: Urgent, threatening language with a short deadline
Generic greeting ('Dear Customer') instead of your name
Sender domain doesn't match the real bank's domain
Link text doesn't show the actual destination URL
humanFactors: Authority (appears to be from the bank)
